Small-Cap Momentum Watch: Upcoming Catalysts for June 8–12
6/7/202610 min read
From operational updates to conference participation, we’ve highlighted the small-cap events that could drive attention this week.
--
Companies Presenting at the American Diabetes Association (ADA) 86th Scientific Sessions 2026
The American Diabetes Association (ADA) 86th Scientific Sessions will take place June 5–8, 2026, at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans, Louisiana. The conference is one of the largest global diabetes meetings, bringing together researchers, clinicians, and industry leaders to present new data and advances in diabetes care, obesity, metabolic disease, and related therapies.
LXRX – will present clinical data on sotagliflozin in Type 1 diabetes and pilavapadin in diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain, including inTandem trial analyses and Phase 1 pharmacokinetic data.
SABS – will deliver an oral presentation on SAB-142, covering clinical safety, pharmacokinetics, immunogenicity, and pharmacodynamic findings in new-onset Type 1 diabetes.
GCTK – will present its fully implantable continuous blood glucose monitoring technology at the ADA Innovation Hub, highlighting direct blood measurement, multi-year implant longevity, and no on-body wearable.
MTVA – will present three late-breaking abstracts on DA-1726 and vanoglipel, covering obesity, glycemic control, weight-loss, and liver health data.
IPSC – will deliver an oral presentation on CNTY-813, its Allo-Evasion™ 5.0-engineered iPSC-derived beta islet replacement therapy for Type 1 diabetes.
BMEA – will present clinical and translational data on icovamenib, including insulin secretion, glycemic control, fat reduction, and lean mass preservation findings.
ELDN – will present updated investigator-initiated trial results on anti-CD40L therapy in islet allotransplantation, focused on graft survival and function.
MNKD – will present new clinical and real-world data on Afrezza® inhaled insulin and FUROSCIX®, including data following Afrezza’s pediatric approval for ages six and older.
Companies Participating at the Goldman Sachs 47th Annual Global Healthcare Conference 2026
The Goldman Sachs 47th Annual Global Healthcare Conference will take place June 8–10, 2026, in Miami, Florida. The conference is one of the healthcare sector’s premier investor events, bringing together executives, institutional investors, and industry leaders to discuss clinical developments, business strategy, market trends, and investment opportunities across biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, healthcare services, and life sciences.
QTRX, GERN, ALT, PGEN, DCGO, FHTX, RXRX, EMBC, CMPX, RCKT, SANA, ABSI, PRME, CTMX, MYGN, FATE, ALVO, CCCC
Companies Participating at the Small Cap Showcase & WTR Insights 2026
The Small Cap Showcase & WTR Insights 2026 will take place June 9, 2026, in New York City. The event is a curated investor forum for micro- and small-cap companies, featuring company presentations, one-on-one investor meetings, guest speakers, and networking opportunities.
BESS, OBAI, SCNX, EPM, VTIX
Companies Presenting at the EHA 2026 Congress
The European Hematology Association (EHA) 2026 Congress will take place June 11–14, 2026, in Stockholm, Sweden. EHA is recognized as Europe's premier hematology meeting, bringing together researchers, clinicians, and industry leaders to showcase the latest advances in blood cancers, cellular therapies, immunotherapy, and hematologic disorders.
CRBU – will deliver two oral presentations. The first will feature Phase 1 ANTLER data for vispa-cel in relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma on Friday, June 12, 2026, from 5:15–6:30 p.m. CEST. The second will provide Phase 1 CaMMouflage follow-up data for CB-011 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma on Sunday, June 14, 2026, from 11:00 a.m.–12:15 p.m. CEST.
CLLS – will present data from two allogeneic CAR-T programs. The oral presentation for lasme-cel / UCART22 from the BALLI-01 trial in relapsed/refractory CD22+ B-cell ALL is scheduled for Saturday, June 13, 2026, from 5:15–6:30 p.m. CET. The poster presentation for eti-cel / UCART20x22 from the NATHALI-01 trial in relapsed/refractory B-cell NHL is scheduled for Saturday, June 13, 2026, from 6:45–7:45 p.m. CET.
CCCC – will present a poster with updated data from its Phase 1 trial evaluating cemsidomide in combination with dexamethasone in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma during EHA 2026, taking place June 11–14, 2026.
EVAX – will present new preclinical data on EVX-04, its AI-designed off-the-shelf therapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia (AML), highlighting the functional characterization of the program as it advances toward planned clinical testing. The poster presentation will showcase EVX-04’s ability to target endogenous retroviral antigens in AML and represents another step toward the company's planned clinical trial application in the second half of 2026. The presentation is scheduled for Saturday, June 13, 2026, from 6:45–7:45 p.m. CET (12:45–1:45 p.m. ET) during Poster Session 2.
Companies Participating at the Jefferies Innovative Aerospace Virtual Summit 2026
The Jefferies Innovative Aerospace Virtual Summit is scheduled for June 8, 2026. The virtual event will feature fireside chats, one-on-one investor meetings, and discussions focused on aerospace innovation, defense technology, autonomous delivery, intelligent infrastructure, and related growth opportunities.
ARAI, SRFM, HOVR
Other Companies with Material Events This Week:
STTK – Hosting an investor call and webcast on June 8, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET to present comprehensive Phase 1 clinical data for SL-325, including safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, receptor occupancy, pharmacodynamic, and immunogenicity results. Management will also provide a pipeline update followed by a Q&A session.
CTKB – Participating at CYTO 2026 in West Palm Beach, Florida, June 6–10, 2026, where it will debut its new 7-laser Cytek Borealis full spectrum flow cytometer and showcase automation-ready Aurora Evo systems. The company will host tutorial sessions on June 8 and June 9 focused on flow cytometry innovation and cloud-based workflow solutions.
AREC – Participating in multiple industry events including the Global Industrials Forum in New York City on June 8, 2026, the Battery and Universal Waste Recycling Conference in Nashville on June 8–9, 2026, and the Atlantic Council Global Energy Forum in Washington, D.C. on June 9–10, 2026, with executives attending panels, meetings, and discussions focused on critical minerals, recycling, and energy infrastructure.
INO – Participating in the World Orphan Drug Congress in Boston with a poster presentation titled “Rare Disease Protein Replacement Therapeutics: The Transformational Potential of Next-Gen DNA Medicine” on June 11, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. ET.
IVVD – Participating in the H.C. Wainwright HCW @ Home Series with a virtual fireside chat on June 8, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET.
RZLV – Presenting a peer-reviewed research paper on AI-powered commerce and recommendation accuracy at ACM UMAP 2026 in Gothenburg, Sweden, June 8–11, 2026, highlighting developments in agentic commerce and AI transaction systems.
MTVA – Presenting a corporate update on its obesity and metabolic disease pipeline at the Emerging Growth Conference on June 11, 2026, at 3:25 p.m. ET.
HYPD – Participating in ETHConf 2026 in New York City, June 8–10, 2026, a major blockchain and Web3 developer conference.
ZENA – Exhibiting at the Future Force Capabilities Conference & Exhibition 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, June 8–10, 2026, where its ZenaDrone division will showcase autonomous drone technologies and engage with military and defense industry leaders.
CLDI – Participating in a RedChip investor webinar on June 9, 2026, at 4:15 p.m. ET, where management will discuss the RedTail targeted virotherapy platform, progress of lead candidate CLD-401, recent preclinical data, and upcoming development milestones.
AMBP – Participating in the Wells Fargo 16th Annual Industrials & Materials Conference in Chicago with a fireside chat on June 9, 2026.
CDIO – Participating in the Conner Strong & Buckelew Health & Benefits Innovation Summit in Philadelphia on June 9, 2026, and the Midwest Employee Benefit Funds Coalition Annual Meeting in Illinois on June 12, 2026.
SBC – Presenting at the Emerging Growth Conference 93 on June 11, 2026, at 9:40 a.m. ET.
ALLO – Participating in the H.C. Wainwright 4th Annual Cell Therapy Virtual Conference on June 9, 2026.
SKYX – Showcasing and promoting its smart electrical technologies through licensing partner Eurofase at the Hotel & Cruise Ship Expo in Miami on June 9–10, 2026, targeting hospitality and commercial building markets.
BMR – Presenting its ML-safe video data stack for autonomous vehicles at AutoSens USA 2026 in Detroit, June 9–11, 2026, focusing on AI-enabled data solutions for AV and ADAS applications.
TBLA – Participating in the Rosenblatt Age of AI Conference with a fireside chat on June 9, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET.
CMND – Hosting a live webinar titled “Inside MEAI: Exclusive Investigator Q&A with Yale & Johns Hopkins” on June 10, 2026, from 12:00–1:00 p.m. EDT, featuring discussion of clinical data from its ongoing Phase I/IIa trial evaluating CMND-100 for Alcohol Use Disorder.
NWTG – Presenting at the Emerging Growth Conference on June 11, 2026, at 1:10 p.m. ET, followed by a live Q&A session.
RSSS – Presenting at the East Coast IDEAS Investor Conference in New York on June 10, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. ET, with management also conducting investor meetings.
MSS – CFO Alexandria Lopez has been named a nominee for the 2026 LA Executive Awards. The LA Executive Forum & Leadership Awards will take place on June 8, 2026, in Santa Monica, California.
SABS – Presenting data on SAB-142 at the Federation of Clinical Immunology Societies (FOCIS) Annual Meeting in San Francisco, June 9–12, 2026, highlighting its lead immunotherapy candidate for newly diagnosed Type 1 Diabetes patients.
OVID – Participating in the Oppenheimer CNS & Neuro-Muscular Summit on June 10, 2026, at 3:45 p.m. ET.
LIDR – Showcasing a live intelligent transportation system deployment with the Michigan Department of Transportation at ITS America 2026 in Detroit, June 10–12, 2026, demonstrating its lidar-based traffic monitoring platform.
UIS – Presenting at the East Coast IDEAS Conference in New York on June 10, 2026, at 11:15 a.m. ET.
NSRX – Hosting a virtual KOL event on June 10, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET focused on the treatment landscape and unmet needs in anaphylaxis, featuring leading allergy and immunology experts.
NUAI – Participating in the Macquarie AI Infrastructure Conference in New York on June 10, 2026, and the Maxim Group AI Data Center Virtual Summit on June 11, 2026, including a fireside chat.
BZAI – Participating in the D.A. Davidson Technology & Consumer Conference in Nashville on June 10–12, 2026, including a fireside chat on June 11, 2026, at 4:35 p.m. CDT.
GRWG – Participating in Oppenheimer’s 26th Annual Consumer Growth and E-Commerce Conference on June 10, 2026.
ATAI – Participating in the Oppenheimer CNS & Neuro-Muscular Summit on June 10, 2026, including a fireside chat at 1:35 p.m. ET and one-on-one investor meetings.
SABR – Participating in the Bank of America Technology, Media & Telecom Conference with a fireside chat on June 10, 2026, at 10:40 a.m. ET.
COCH – Expected to receive grant approval for European Patent No. 4297862 on June 10, 2026, covering technology related to rechargeable implantable battery systems and thermal management.
EEIQ – Presenting at the Emerging Growth Conference on June 11, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET.
NAGE – Presenting at the East Coast IDEAS Investor Conference in New York on June 11, 2026.
AGNT – Participating in the D.A. Davidson Technology & Consumer Conference in Nashville on June 11, 2026, conducting one-on-one investor meetings.
HUMA – Expected to report top-line interim results from its V012 Phase 3 dialysis access study on June 11, 2026, during the Society of Vascular Surgery Vascular Annual Meeting (VAM) in Boston. Positive results could support an sBLA submission in the second half of 2026.
DIBS – Participating in the East Coast IDEAS Investor Conference in New York on June 11, 2026.
ALIT – Participating in the D.A. Davidson Technology & Consumer Conference in Nashville on June 11, 2026, conducting one-on-one investor meetings.
IDN – Participating in the D.A. Davidson Technology & Consumer Conference in Nashville on June 11, 2026, with management hosting one-on-one investor meetings.
HTOO – Holding an Extraordinary General Meeting on June 8, 2026, where shareholders will vote on the proposed Royal Uranium acquisition, conversion of preferred shares, and changing the company name to Fusion Elements plc.
HFFG – Participating in the D.A. Davidson Technology & Consumer Conference in Nashville on June 11, 2026, with management conducting one-on-one investor meetings.
EDIT – Presenting preclinical data at the 2026 National Lipid Association Sessions in Scottsdale, Arizona, June 11–14, 2026, highlighting an in vivo CRISPR gene-editing program designed to reduce LDL-C and Lp(a).
LPCN – Hosting a virtual Key Opinion Leader event on June 12, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET, discussing postpartum depression and the clinical profile of LPCN 1154 (BRLIZIO™).
DGNX – Announced that the outside date for its proposed Resulticks acquisition has been extended from May 29, 2026, to June 12, 2026, as closing conditions continue to be finalized.
RZLT – Presenting four abstracts at ENDO 2026 in Chicago, June 13–16, 2026, including an oral presentation of Phase 3 sunRIZE data for ersodetug (RZ358) in congenital hyperinsulinism on June 13, along with multiple poster presentations.
OCGN – Participating in Clinical Trials at the Summit 2026 in Las Vegas on June 13, 2026, with management joining a panel discussion on innovation in inherited retinal diseases.
ENTX – Presenting multiple abstracts at ENDO 2026 in Chicago, June 13–16, 2026, including a late-breaking oral presentation on EB613 supporting Phase 3 development in osteoporosis and additional data on obesity candidate EB618.
ENSC – Participating in the College on Problems of Drug Dependence (CPDD) 88th Annual Meeting in Portland, Oregon, June 13–17, 2026, providing updates on its PF614 and PF614-MPAR programs and development strategy.
MYSE – Exhibiting at the Florida Bridal & Wedding Expo in Fort Lauderdale on June 14, 2026, promoting its Picture Party social media and event-sharing platform.
XOS – Exhibiting at the Government Fleet Expo & Conference (GFX) 2026 in Long Beach, California, June 9–12, 2026, showcasing battery-electric fleet vehicles and mobile energy solutions.
AMBO – Launching the HybriU Partner Portal, an AI-native channel platform for education and event markets, while participating in activities surrounding the AIA Conference on Architecture & Design in San Diego, June 10–13, 2026.
PDC – Presenting at the Emerging Growth Conference on June 10, 2026, at 4:10 p.m. ET, including a live investor Q&A session.
FFAI – Serving as a presenting sponsor at the Summer 2026 Educational Panel & Networking Event in Providence, Rhode Island, on June 11, 2026, with executive presentations and investor engagement.
APM – Extended the merger agreement with DiamiR through June 30, 2026 while continuing efforts to satisfy closing conditions. Following completion, former DiamiR shareholders are expected to own approximately 70% of the combined company, with Aptorum shareholders owning approximately 30%.

The Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference 2026 will take place June 2–4, 2026, in New York City. The event brings together healthcare executives, institutional investors, private equity investors, and venture capitalists for company presentations, fireside chats, and one-on-one or small group meetings across biotechnology, life sciences tools and services, medical technology, and pharmaceuticals.

Major multi-company gatherings include the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference (June 2–4), William Blair’s Growth Stock Conference (June 2–3) and the Noble Capital Markets Emerging Growth Virtual Equity Conference (June 3–4). Small-Cap Momentum Watch: Upcoming Catalysts for May 26–29
5/25/20267 min read
From operational updates to conference participation, we’ve highlighted the small-cap events that could drive attention this week.
--
Companies Presenting at EASL Congress 2026
EASL Congress 2026 will take place May 27–30, 2026, at Fira Barcelona Gran Via in Barcelona, Spain, with hybrid in-person and online participation. The event is Europe’s largest hepatology congress, bringing together clinicians, researchers, allied health professionals, patients, and industry partners to discuss liver disease research, clinical advances, and emerging therapies.
Participating companies include: ● PRQR • AVIR • MTVA • GALT • CMMB
Companies Participating in the 23rd Annual Craig-Hallum Institutional Investor Conference
The 23rd Annual Craig-Hallum Institutional Investor Conference will take place on Thursday, May 28, 2026, at the Depot Renaissance Hotel in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The event focuses on small- and mid-cap equities, with structured one-on-one meetings between institutional investors and management teams from public companies.
Participating companies include: ● MDXG • PYPD • CREX • SWIM • ALTO • AIOT
Companies Participating in the TD Cowen 7th Annual Oncology Innovation Summit
The TD Cowen 7th Annual Oncology Innovation Summit: Insights for ASCO & EHA is scheduled for May 26–27, 2026. The event will feature multiple sessions across the two days focused on oncology innovation, ASCO and EHA-related insights, company updates, and investor discussions.
Participating companies include: ● ACRV • PEPG • TARA • CCCC ● NUVB • ZNTL • WHWK
Companies Participating in the Lytham Partners Spring 2026 Investor Conference
The Lytham Partners Spring 2026 Investor Conference will take place virtually on Thursday, May 28, 2026. The event will feature company webcast presentations, interactive sessions, and virtual one-on-one meetings between corporate management teams and registered investors.
Participating companies include: ● JAGX • DYAI • BFRI • IPM ● CVKD • SNES • POCI • AYTU
Companies Presenting at the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting
The 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting will take place from May 29 to June 2, 2026, at McCormick Place in Chicago, Illinois, with virtual attendance options available. The program begins Friday, May 29 at 1:00 PM CT and concludes Tuesday, June 2 at 12:45 PM CT. The event will feature more than 200 sessions, over 7,000 scientific abstracts, industry exhibits, poster presentations, Innovation Zone programming, and networking opportunities across oncology-focused communities of practice.
Participating companies include: ● ONCY • BCTX • BLRX • CATX • PLRX • AUTL ● MBRX • APRE • CMPX • BCYC • FATE • BYSI ● CCCC • OABI • CLRB • BDTX • REPL • RNXT ● GNPX • IMMP • XBIO • AGEN • CRDF • INO
Other companies with material events this week:
PROP - Senior management will participate in the 26th Annual Louisiana Energy Conference, being held May 26–28, 2026, at the Four Seasons in New Orleans, Louisiana.
LPCN - Phase 3 clinical data for LPCN 1154 were selected for oral and poster presentations at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Psychopharmacology Annual Meeting, taking place May 26–29, 2026, in Miami, Florida.
BGL - Will host an investor webinar on May 26, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET. CEO Andrew Cavaghan will discuss Blue Gold’s mine-to-wallet strategy, new corporate website, and development of the Standard Gold Coin and STANDARD wallet ecosystem.
HITI - Raj Grover will participate at Cannabis Europa in London on May 26, 2026, in the session “Deal Flow & Due Diligence: Inside Europe’s Next M&A Wave.”
STSS - Announced a strategic collaboration to strengthen Solana’s institutional infrastructure. STSS will delegate a portion of its SOL treasury holdings to Stakin by The Tie, and The Tie will host Innovate Miami on May 26, 2026.
EQ - Will host a virtual investor event on May 27, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET, featuring new preclinical data on AhR modulators and the relationship between AhR activation and miR-124 induction.
CFND - Executive management will attend Benchmark’s Digital Assets Summit on May 27, 2026, followed by a non-deal roadshow in New York City on May 28–29, 2026.
FRMM - Chairman and CEO McAndrew Rudisill and SVP John Kristoff are expected to participate in the Benchmark Digital Assets Summit on May 27, 2026, in New York.
HTOO - Will release an investor update video and presentation on May 27, 2026, covering recent progress, operational priorities, 2026 milestones, the Royal Uranium acquisition agreement, and its diversified energy platform strategy.
GTN - Will participate in the 11th Annual Goldman Sachs Leveraged Finance Conference on May 27, 2026, in Dana Point, California.
TBLA - Will participate in the TD Cowen Tech, Media and Telecom Conference on May 27, 2026, with a fireside chat scheduled for 3:35 p.m. ET.
HOVR - Will participate in CANSEC 2026, taking place May 27–28, 2026, at the EY Centre in Ottawa.
HYPD - Will participate in Chardan’s Crypto Salon: Believe the HYPE! on May 27, 2026, in New York.
RMNI - Will participate in TD Cowen’s 54th Annual Technology, Media & Telecom Conference on May 27, 2026, in New York City.
KOPN - Will host its Minneapolis Technology Demo Day on May 27, 2026, as part of its 2026 Technology Demo Days Tour.
NCPL - Will host a business update conference call on May 28, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. ET. CEO Todd Violette will discuss Netcapital’s strategic direction, business transformation, near-term priorities, and private capital markets platform.
FFAI - Will present at the Centurion One Capital Inaugural Miami Summit on May 28, 2026, at the Faena Forum in Miami Beach. Global Executive Chairman Jerry Wang will present and participate in investor meetings and panel discussions.
WETO - Will host its inaugural product launch event on May 28, 2026, in Austin, Texas, to launch Orchestra, the Company’s Physical AI operating system.
OABI - Management will hold virtual one-on-one and small group investor meetings at the Benchmark 6th Annual Healthcare House Call Virtual Investor Conference on May 28, 2026.
NWL - Declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share, payable June 15, 2026, to common stockholders of record as of May 29, 2026.
MNKD - Afrezza has a pediatric indication PDUFA target action date of May 29, 2026. If approved, it would be the first and only inhaled insulin option for children and adolescents living with diabetes.
STKE - Entered into a definitive agreement to acquire HoudiniSwap LLC for $18 million in cash, shares, a promissory note, and warrants, with closing expected on or before May 29, 2026, subject to customary conditions including CSE approval.
MOLN - Will present at Antibody & Engineering Therapeutics, taking place May 27–29, 2026, in Basel, Switzerland. The presentation, “Radio-DARPins for targeted alpha therapy: first in human insights with MP0712 and opportunities for future candidates,” is scheduled for May 29 at 4:45–5:15 p.m. local time.
TOMZ - Recently executed a non-binding LOI to merge with Carbonium Core, a U.S.-based producer of nuclear-grade graphite for advanced reactor technologies and AI data center infrastructure. Definitive agreements are expected on or before May 30, 2026, subject to due diligence and stockholder approval.
ATNM - Will present three abstracts at the SNMMI 2026 Annual Meeting, taking place May 30–June 2, 2026, in Los Angeles. One presentation, “Optimizing Chelator-to-Antibody Ratio Improves Tumor Targeting and Pharmacokinetics of 225Ac-Labeled Antibodies,” is scheduled for May 31, 2026, from 7:30–8:00 p.m. PT.
LBGJ - Its subsidiary entered into a new equity transfer agreement to acquire a 51% equity interest in Suzhou Yufengyuan Food Distribution Co., Ltd., with closing expected on or before May 30, 2026. The new agreement removes the prior special voting arrangement to enhance purchaser control.
ALP - GAMEE acquisition is projected to close by May 31, 2026, pending final audits of GAMEE HK and Czech Republic. The company also highlighted continued growth of strategic partnerships including Telegram Cocoon, Animoca Brands, and Midnight Network.
BCHT - Will participate in the American Society for Mass Spectrometry 2026 Conference, taking place May 31–June 4, 2026, in San Diego. Dr. Nicholas Lentz will speak during the Agilent Technologies User Group Meeting on May 31 and participate in a technical poster Q&A session on June 3.
SXTP - Submitted a New Dietary Ingredient Notification to the FDA for Australian Chestnut Extract. The FDA has until May 25, 2026, to object, after which the Company would be free to market its planned dietary supplement.
OCGN - Will participate in the Stifel 2026 Virtual Ophthalmology Forum on May 26, 2026, from 10:30–10:55 a.m. EDT.
SGHT - Will participate in the Stifel 2026 Virtual Ophthalmology Forum on May 26, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. PT / 12:00 p.m. ET.
DGNX - Extended the outside date for completion of its proposed all-share acquisition of Resulticks, valued at $1.5 billion, to May 31, 2026, as both parties finalize financing arrangements and remaining closing workstreams.
--
